steps.js: const p=document.querySelector('.v3-page'); return {imgs:[...p.querySelectorAll('img')].filter(i=>i.getBoundingClientRect().width>60).length, 首帧:/首帧/.test(p.innerText), 尾帧:/尾帧/.test(p.innerText), 视频:/视频/.test(p.innerText), 详情:/分镜详情|配乐|环境/.test(p.innerText), eps:(p.innerText.match(/第 \d+ 集/g)||[]).length}
const p=document.body.innerText; return {cand:(p.match(/首帧候选[^\n]{0,20}/g)||[]).slice(0,3), draft:/草图·还没进版本|新图·未登记/.test(p), none:/还没有首帧/.test(p)}

const big=[...document.querySelectorAll('img')].map(i=>i.getBoundingClientRect()).filter(r=>r.height>innerHeight*0.6).length; return {big, use:[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].map(b=>b.innerText.trim()).filter(t=>/用这张|设为当前/.test(t)).slice(0,3), cmp:/对比/.test(document.body.innerText), none:/还没有首帧/.test(document.body.innerText)}
return {btn:[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].map(b=>b.innerText.trim()).filter(t=>/出视频|生成视频/.test(t)).slice(0,3), gate:(document.body.innerText.match(/[^\n]*才能出视频[^\n]*/)||[null])[0]}

const t=document.body.innerText; return {crash:/页面出错/.test(t), tabs:['音色','旁白','对白','配乐'].filter(x=>t.includes(x)), players:document.querySelectorAll('.mp-audio,.mp-ab,.mp-play').length, waveBars:document.querySelectorAll('.mp-wave i').length, audio:document.querySelectorAll('audio').length}
